question: Find the percentage of non-carcinogenic molecules (label = '-') among those that contain at least one carbon atom and also have a bond involving a lead (pb) atom.

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m."XCL_011" = '-' THEN m."XCL_010" ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT m."XCL_010") AS percentage
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m."XCL_010" IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a."XCL_002"
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a."XCL_003" = 'c'
)
AND m."XCL_010" IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT b."XCL_005"
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN connected AS c ON c."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004"
    JOIN atom AS a ON a."XCL_001" = c."XCL_007"
    WHERE a."XCL_003" = 'pb'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT b."XCL_005"
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN connected AS c ON c."XCL_009" = b."XCL_004"
    JOIN atom AS a ON a."XCL_001" = c."XCL_008"
    WHERE a."XCL_003" = 'pb'
);
